purpose: Independent saved-evidence analysis of c954 versus isolated five-file M9 trial
adoptionRecommendation: Adopt the two narrow mechanisms after coordinator review; full M9 and final integrated acceptance remain open.
method: For each case/metric, take each process sample median, then the median of the two process medians per arm. Pair run 1 and run 2 separately; no pooled-sample confidence or percentile claim. CPU and serialization are separate from service wall time.
flagRule: Both paired run medians above baseline by >10% and >1 ms; investigation signal only, not universal user-impact threshold.
limitations: Two fresh process observations per arm for each lane; samples within a process are correlated.
No browser, HTTP/concurrent client, network-latency or whole-application timing measurement.
No retained heap/RSS/GC lane; temporary allocation reduction is established by work counters, not measured memory improvement.
JSON diagnostics count JavaScript string characters, not allocation bytes or UTF-8 wire bytes; input/outputBytes are UTF-8 bytes.
Wide summary still parses 85,714,734 map characters and emits only 7,332 output bytes at 24 maps.
Full wide response retains necessary approximately87 MB payload; full serialization costs remain.
No comparison uses excluded508 or labels isolated results as an integrated c954 outcome.
